description: Returns where one order for collection is (received, accepted, being made, ready, collected or cancelled), when it should be ready, whether it is paid, and the collection code said at the counter. It takes the tracking code that was given with the order's basket, or the one in an email from the restaurant about the order. It gives no name, no contact details and no list of what was ordered, and changes nothing.

code.description: The tracking code, as it was given: letters and digits in groups of four.
